Tenant settings console: 23 operator-configurable domains in one tabbed page
Per-tab settings visibility and read-only enforcement for manager role
Settings tab deep-linking via ?tab= query parameter
Blog toggle and booking-settings reset gate on tab key 'rental', which is not in allSettingsTabs — canEditSettings('rental') never matches a real tab
Light-to-dark brand colour synchronisation for tenant palettes
Rationale: each brand colour exists three times (base, light_*, dark_*); booking site commonly renders dark, so editing only light colours changes nothing for customers
The three brand colours eligible for dark sync (primary, secondary, accent)
Effective brand colour resolution — theme-specific value else base fallback
Non-destructive save-time dark colour sync plan

Rationale: dark is refreshed only when the light COLUMN itself changed and isAutoDerivedDark confirms nobody hand-picked it; must accept a dark derived from the BASE colour because buildTenantPalette provisions tenants that way, else the sync is a permanent no-op
Explicit destructive 'Sync dark theme from light' action — does overwrite hand-picked dark colours
Before/after hex preview shown before the destructive dark sync is confirmed
WCAG relative-luminance foreground colour picker for brand previews
Rationale: previews hardcoded text-white, making a pale brand colour render as unreadable white-on-yellow and misrepresent the real component, which pairs each colour with its *-foreground token
Inline 'showing the default — not set for this theme' hint on inheriting colour pickers
Tenant brand identity: app name, logo, favicon, base/light/dark palettes, backgrounds
Branding dirty detection — 19-field comparison against saved tenant branding
Revert unsaved branding edits back to saved tenant branding
Persist branding, running the save-time dark sync first
Branding written twice: tenants table (source of truth for useDynamicTheme) and org_settings for backward compatibility

Rationale: logo_url is deliberately NOT sent on branding save — the logo persists on upload, and tenantBranding's placeholder always has logo_url null (portal TenantContext never selects it), so echoing it back silently wiped tenant logos
Rationale: never fall back to the platform brand 'Drive 917' for Application Name — tenants without app_name would display it and then persist it into tenants.app_name on the next save
SEO and social-share metadata: meta title, description, OG image
GA4 / Google tag measurement ID validation with corrective hints for GTM- and UA- IDs
Rationale: the accepted formats must match the booking site's gtag loader EXACTLY (G- and GT- only), or the green hint promises analytics that never load
Header/footer colour — the only setting controlling booking-site nav, footer and customer-portal sidebar
Reset all branding to platform defaults
Rationale: header/footer colours were previously omitted from the reset payload, so custom values survived a 'Reset All to Defaults'
Booking-site light/dark policy — two friendly controls composed into the customer_theme_mode enum (light | dark | light_only | dark_only)
Persist booking-site theme mode optimistically

Rationale: controls rendered straight off `tenant` only move after the write AND a full tenant refetch return, so the switch sat visibly in its old position and read as broken; the pending value lets it move on click and still be corrected by the server
Zero-row UPDATE guard — .select() the written column and treat an empty result as a permissions failure

Rationale: tenants has RLS enabled and PostgREST reports a zero-row UPDATE as error:null, indistinguishable from success — users outside an UPDATE policy saw 'updated', changed nothing, and watched the control snap back
Generic optimistic writer for boolean tenant flags with RLS zero-row guard

Rationale: a bare return on missing tenant made the click completely dead — nothing moved, nothing written, no error; and the message must say 'not finished loading', because the portal resolves its tenant from the subdomain, not the signed-in account
Per-tenant optional feature toggles surfaced under General
Vehicle Owners & Owner Payouts module toggle (adds sidebar entries)
Gig Driver booking option toggle — shows 'Are you a gig driver?' on the booking page
Plate/VIN suppression across the public booking site, invoices, statements and customer emails
Rationale/caveat: photos are not covered by registration hiding — a legible plate in a vehicle photo must be replaced or hidden separately
Customer pricing-display preferences: effective average daily rate on vehicle cards, and hiding the weekday/weekend checkout breakdown
ID-verification waiver — lets staff create rentals without verification, with a mandatory reason recorded on the rental and in the audit log

Rationale: only head_admin may relax an identity control; isAdmin() is not equivalent because it includes plain admin, and super admins pass because the auth store rewrites them to head_admin. Default is FALSE so the safe state is what you get by doing nothing
Tenant columns written here but consumed only by the customer-facing booking app
Regional settings: currency code and distance unit, dual-written to org_settings and tenants
Persist general/regional settings and policy versions
Bumping privacy policy or terms version nulls tenants.policies_accepted_at, forcing staff re-acceptance
Unsaved-changes protection across tab switches and navigation, driven by per-form dirty tracking
Save every dirty settings form for the 'Save & Leave' path
Tab-switch guard — intercepts a tab change while the current tab is dirty
Rental & booking operational settings form — one ~45-field state object covering tax, fees, deposits, durations, lockbox, PAYG, auto-extend and blog
Booking lead time and min/max rental duration limits, with hours/days unit conversion
Monthly pricing tier threshold — also drives mileage allowance and extension pricing
Buffer/cooldown minutes after a rental before the vehicle is bookable again
Return reminder — email/SMS N hours before scheduled return, checked every 15 minutes, once per rental
Tax rate and service fee (percentage or fixed) configuration

Rationale: the tax rate is held as a raw string while typing so decimals can be entered (per-keystroke Number conversion drops the trailing dot), collapsed to one dot and clipped to 2 decimals because the column is numeric(5,2)
Pre-authorisation / security deposit: global amount or per-vehicle mode
Pay As You Go — rental, tax and percentage fees accrue daily and are billed in arrears
PAYG upfront payment requirement gates the 'Confirm Collection' key handover until the first period is paid
Auto-extension — periods billed UPFRONT via saved-card auto-charge or emailed pay-link, with lead time, grace window and retry caps
Rationale: auto-extension is the exact opposite of Pay As You Go — one bills upfront per period, the other bills in arrears after the period is used
Lockbox key handover configuration: enable, code length, delivery channel, auto-send timing
Lockbox delivery channel gated on tenant integrations — SMS needs integration_twilio_sms, WhatsApp needs integration_twilio_whatsapp
Auto-send lockbox code N minutes after rental approval (or manual only)
Blog feature toggle for the customer-facing booking website
Reset all booking/rental settings to documented defaults
Promo code management — create, edit, delete, list per tenant
Deterministic unique promo code generator: {promo_id}{first-3-of-name}{value}, incrementing until unused
Promo code regenerator for the edit dialog
Auto-apply duration discount — min_duration_days turns a code into an automatic tier applied without customer entry, highest matching tier wins

Rationale: auto duration discounts apply to fixed rentals paid in full only — never to installment plans, pay-as-you-go, or auto-extension renewals; Max Users still caps redemptions and a used-up tier falls through to the next one down
Manual payment-reapplication maintenance run with recorded start/finish, duration and outcome counts
Recent maintenance-run history (last 3)
Maintenance runs query and the reapply RPC carry no tenant filter and no tenant_id in the query key — this operator action is platform-wide, not tenant-scoped
Settings audit trail — logs setting saves, promo mutations, and even the reset-warning dialog being shown
